name: test_file
description: test_file must run one Zig test file and report the verdict. The file asserted is tools/zig/cards.zig, which build.zig lists as host-testable — `zig build test` compiles and runs its test blocks on every gate, so it is kept permanently green by construction and the expectation is content-independent: a known-good test file must come back ok regardless of what its tests cover that week. Exercises the exec_allow path (zig) plus argv assembly (the `test` subcommand before the file).
prompt: Use the zig_test tool with file "tools/zig/cards.zig" and no filter. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
